name: united-site-pronto-2026-10-21
description: Fonte editável e candidato de produção United — revisão de 21/10/2026

scripts.build: npm run blog:render && npm run build:preview && node tools/build-production.mjs && npm run validate && npm run audit:seo && npm run manifest
scripts.audit:seo: npm run audit:seo:preview && npm run audit:seo:production
scripts.audit:seo:preview: node tools/audit-seo.mjs --source src --target preview --mode preview --config release.config.json --report reports/seo-preview.json
scripts.audit:seo:production: node tools/audit-seo.mjs --source src --target dist --mode production --config release.config.json --report reports/seo-production.json
scripts.review: npm run blog:render && npm run build:preview && npm run audit:seo:preview
